# Interpolation Fix - v1.2.0
## Server Opt-In and Settings Screen
### PLUGIN UPDATES
**Server opt-in**: The fix now turns on by default only for servers that support it, and in singleplayer, so it can't get you flagged on servers whose anticheat expects 26.3.
**Three modes**: Pick Server Opt-In (default), Always, or Off. The keybind now cycles through them.
**Mod Menu screen**: Change the mode in game and see whether the server you're on supports the fix.
**AntiStutter servers**: Servers that support LokaMC's AntiStutter turn the fix on too.
**Paper plugin**: Server owners can opt in by dropping the Interpolation Fix plugin into their plugins folder (Paper, Purpur and Folia 1.21.6+).
### PLUGIN CHANGES
**Fabric API**: Now required.
**Existing settings**: If you left the fix on in v1.1.0, you're moved to Always. If you turned it off, it stays Off.

# Interpolation Fix - v1.1.0
## Toggle Keybind
### PLUGIN UPDATES
**Toggle keybind**: Added "Toggle Interpolation Fix" under Controls > Misc. Press it to switch between the 26.2 smoothing and vanilla 26.3 smoothing instantly, no rejoining needed. It's unbound by default so it never clashes with your other keys.
**Remembers your choice**: The on/off setting is saved and kept between restarts.
### PLUGIN CHANGES
**Anticheat warning**: Servers whose anticheat is built around 26.3 can flag the fix for Reach. Turn it off before joining one, or keep it for recordings.

# Interpolation Fix - v1.0.0
## Initial Release
### PLUGIN UPDATES
**Smooth entity movement**: Restores the Minecraft 26.2 movement smoothing for players and mobs, fixing the stutter introduced in 26.3 (MC-311974).
**Client-side only**: Works on any server with no server mod or plugin, and does not require Fabric API.
## ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️
Any server whose anticheat is **modeled specifically on 26.3** will **flag you for Reach and can ban you**. Use this mod with heavy caution, preferably for recordings rather than combat.

| Servers       | Allows 26.3? | Tested? | Flagged? | Bannable? |
|---------------|--------------|---------|----------|-----------|
| mcpvp.com     | ✅           | ✅      | ✅       | ✅        |
| mcpvp.club    | ✅           | ✅      | ❓       | ❓        |
| minemen.club  | ✅           | ✅      | ❓       | ❌        |
| pvphq.net     | ❌           | ❓      | ❓       | ❓        |
| pvplegacy.com | ❌           | ❓      | ❓       | ❓        |
| donutsmp.net  | ✅           | ✅      | ❓       | ❓        |
| pvptiers.com  | ❌           | ❓      | ❓       | ❓        |

Any server that runs anticheats on 26.2 or lower with the old interpolation combined with ViaVersion will continue using the old interpolation which should theoretically make you safe.
